title: Great Backslot
description: a simple mod that adds a backslot for new versons
body:
A quite simple mod that adds a weapon backslot for new versons.

i made it cus i could not find one for new versons, so here you go.

this is a really basic back slot mod, it adds a slot in your invintory for the backslot.
